snippet.text:
/**
 * Writes every valid miss of the stored comparisons with one of the reasons asked for as the misses file the measurement tool reads, naming on standard
 * error each one it leaves out and why. It refuses to write a file with no miss, which the tool would refuse to read.
 */

message.text: AGENTS.md requires: "TSDoc only on exported package API. Nothing on internals." This TSDoc documents exportMisses, which the CLI package entry does not export.

evidence.snippet: /** The valid misses with one of `reasons` of the comparisons an export would show, to review again in the clone `repo`. */
